technique_name: Create a short story about what you think happened to the character after the story ended.
description:
John had spent the morning packing up his stuff and saying goodbye to his friends. He was looking forward to his summer holiday, but he was anxious about his future. He had dreams of travelling and exploring the world, but he was worried that he wouldn't have the funds to do so.

John began to walk home, taking in the sights and sounds he had grown so accustomed to at his university. As he walked, he noticed a small music shop tucked away in a corner. He had walked past it dozens of times before
example: John had just finished his last exam and was walking out of the college campus, happily looking forward to the summer break.
